title: Be a partner in God’s Mission. Help make it happen
speaker: Ptra. Cathy
series: Be a partner in God’s Mission. Help make it happen
blurb: Paul thanks the church in Philippi for standing with him, not only in prayer but in giving, again and again, when no other church did. Ptra. Cathy calls us to be more than spectators of God’s mission: to be partners and helpers who make it happen.
takeaways: Partnership in the gospel is practical. The Philippians shared in Paul’s hardship with what they had, more than once (vv. 14–16).
Paul was not after the gift but the fruit: what we give to God’s work is credited to our own account (v. 17).
Generosity rests on a promise. The God who receives our offering is the God who supplies every need of ours (v. 19).
question: Where could you move from cheering God’s mission on to actually helping make it happen this month?
